summary: Bon Natural Life Limited, a Xi'an-based natural-ingredient maker listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K reporting unaudited interim results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. Revenue rose 1.9% to $8.10 million, but operations swung to an $8.58 million loss from $0.28 million income, and net loss attributable to the company was $9.20 million versus $0.17 million net income a year earlier. Basic and diluted loss per Class A ordinary share was $1.51, against $0.56 basic earnings per share in the prior-year half. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings update with no special-situations mechanics or risk-arb angle.
